The other worker is very close—within arm’s reach—standing ahead and slightly left of the camera wearer, facing the open electrical equipment rather than the wearer. The wearer’s hand can reach the white support/leg, where visible rust or damage appears near the joint. Neither person blocks the other’s path, but the nearby worker is best positioned to inspect the issue. Pointing out the damage is safer and more appropriate than handling or demonstrating the equipment.
